gloss: special report; breaking news; news flash

definitions.gloss: special report; breaking news; news flash
definitions.explanation: An urgent or special news bulletin that interrupts regular programming or stands out as particularly important. Also used for special promotional announcements, such as movie trailers.

examples.japanese: {特報|とくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}りました→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.notes: Standard phrasing used by TV news anchors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}{映画|えいが}→新作映画：25174_shinsakueiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特報|とくほう}⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A special preview clip of the new movie was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特報|とくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An earthquake alert was displayed on the TV screen.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {特|とく} (special) + {報|ほう} (report, news). Used in two main contexts: (1) urgent or breaking news in journalism, and (2) short promotional clips or teasers for upcoming movies, games, or other media (shorter and earlier than a full ⟦{予告編|よこくへん}→予告編：20437_yokokuhen⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特報|とくほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (breaking news comes in)
- {特報|とくほう}⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ (special preview footage)
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{特報|とくほう} (urgent breaking news)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: breaking news, flash report — emphasizes speed of reporting
- ⟦{予告編|よこくへん}→予告編：20437_yokokuhen⟧: trailer, preview — a longer promotional clip for a movie
